//: Standalone typecheck for the e2e suite.
It is deliberately NOT referenced from ../tsconfig.json: `npm run build` runs
the production build must not depend on Playwright types being installed.
//include: `../playwright.mutation.config.ts` was MISSING from this list and is now here.
It was the only Playwright config the typecheck did not see, so a type error in
it — a wrong option name, a stale import from e2e/mutation/env.ts — would have
surfaced only when the mutation suite was actually run.
`../playwright.bench.config.ts` then repeated that defect and is now here too.
`**/*.ts` is rooted at e2e/, and nothing imports the bench config, so it was
invisible to the typecheck — verified with `tsc --listFiles`, which named only
two configs. It is worse than the mutation case it repeats: the bench suite is
run BY HAND and rarely, so a break in it would sit undetected far longer.
